prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production pixel-art sprite sheet for Scrapper. Edit the referenced crew sheet to show ACTUAL TENTACLE COILS wrapped around each character, replacing every pose. Preserve EXACT character identities and pixel style. Reference 1 is crew: rows top-bottom Rook orange sealed salvage armor/cyan visor, Echo violet sealed armor/cyan visor, Flint teal green armor/cyan visor, EOS white robot armor and blue holographic face. Reference 2 is tentacle material and silhouette. Create exactly 8 columns by 4 rows, 32 separate full-body poses, generous transparent gutters and margins, consistent baseline, scale and centered pivot per equal-sized cell. Landscape 2:1 sheet. Every row same sequential action: col0 a loose coil winds around thighs and waist with startled arms; col1 two tight coils fully restrain waist and chest arms pulling; col2 struggling torso leans left with coil stretched; col3 struggling torso leans right with coil stretched opposite; col4 crouched forward shoulder heave; col5 leaning back kicking leg straining coils; col6 explosive arms-out break-free with torn tentacle loops thrown away; col7 recovered crouched landing with discarded coil fragments near boots. Strongly different silhouettes for each pose, show hands physically gripping tentacle during struggle, both in-front and behind-body coils integrated naturally, no floating ring pasted on. Coils do NOT cover face. All frames include entire character, no clipping, no titles/text/grid lines or scenery. Sharp detailed old-school shooter pixel art, black outlines and limited clustered shading. Genuine transparent background. Use ONLY tentacle type from reference2 TOP row: purple thorny flesh with acid-green sacs, green goo.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art enemy sprite sheet for the dark industrial shooter Scrapper. Exactly 8 columns and 6 rows on a transparent landscape sheet, 48 fully separated animation frames with generous transparent gutters. A small original alien facehugger: six hooked articulated ivory-chitin legs, flattened dark plum segmented crab-like body, two luminous acid-green eyes, and long flexible purple whip tail with green nodes. Clearly readable front / three-quarter front view aimed toward viewer; no side-facing attack. Match dense shaded crunchy 1990s shooter pixel-art with dark outlines, metallic-organic highlights, no smooth render. Row0 idle breathing legs flex/tail curl. Row1 fast scuttle toward viewer with alternating lifted feet. Row2 attack telegraph: crouch and coil tail, legs gather then spread. Row3 leap head-on toward viewer, abdomen underside visible, legs reach toward camera, then legs clench around imaginary helmet, then release. Row4 hit/stun and falling backward recoil. Row5 death sequence twitch, buckle, violent green goo rupture with chitin fragments, flatten, settled dead husk in last frame. Same scale and center within each cell, entire sprite incl tail, fragments no clipping. No characters or scenery or text. Actual alpha transparency.
